cs.t: Have been super impressed with Taelmoor, a new take on the board game RPG genre that uses a smartphone app as the DM. For a small kickstarted game it plays really smoothly, the build quality is excellent, and the app/physical board interactions are perfect.  https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/delvebros/taelmoor-the-...
